name: 039.16 — the close of the uniform API
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 039.16: the two claims no per-section suite can make — completeness (33 sections callable and handed back by identity, an unknown verb refused by name, and every retired spelling in the migration throwing a message that names its replacement) and the categorical cost claim (naming a section allocates nothing, measured against a call that allocates, and a draw callback naming one costing nothing a frame against the same widget doing work).
